story.paragraph: A digital screen displays a targeting interface over a snowy landscape. Inside a dark room, two men wearing headsets look forward intently while one operates a joystick controller. Outside, a white drone flies through a snowy, mountainous environment. A man in a red jacket and backpack struggles to walk uphill through heavy snow. He takes off the red jacket to reveal a dark green jacket underneath and then kneels down in the snow.
story.summary: Men in a dark room operate a drone targeting system while a man in a red jacket hikes through a snowy mountain and kneels in the snow.
